functionalRequirement: The website shall provide forms for certificates so users can request certificates online.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support all standard certificate request types with comprehensive form fields covering 100% of required information for each certificate category.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures the certificate request functionality is complete and covers all necessary input requirements.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must implement real-time form validation with clear, specific error messages for each input field, preventing submission of incomplete or incorrect certificate request information.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users accurately complete certificate request forms by providing immediate, constructive guidance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Certificate request forms must load within 2 seconds and submit responses within 3 seconds for 99% of requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures responsive and efficient user experience during certificate request process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: All certificate request form data must be encrypted using TLS 1.3 during transmission and at rest using AES-256 encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive personal information submitted during certificate requests.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The certificate request system must maintain 99.9% uptime during business hours (8am-8pm, 7 days a week).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures consistent accessibility for users needing to submit certificate requests.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The certificate request form system must support easy addition or modification of form fields through a configuration interface without requiring code changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows flexible updates to certificate request processes as requirements evolve.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to manage privacy settings such as who can view their profile, connections, and sharing data with third parties.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The privacy settings interface must provide granular control options for profile visibility, connection sharing, and third-party data sharing for all user account types.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures comprehensive privacy management capabilities for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: Privacy settings must be presented with clear, simple language and visual icons representing different privacy levels, with a one-click reset to default privacy settings.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Makes privacy management intuitive and user-friendly.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: Privacy settings changes must be logged with timestamp and IP address, with mandatory two-factor authentication for critical privacy modifications.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects users from unauthorized changes to their privacy settings.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Faultlessness: Privacy settings must be immediately and consistently applied across all platform features within 100 milliseconds of modification.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures immediate and accurate implementation of user privacy preferences.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Adaptability: The privacy settings system must support future privacy regulation compliance with minimal system modifications.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows the platform to quickly adapt to changing privacy laws and user expectations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: Privacy settings must be compatible with major identity and access management standards (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect) for consistent cross-platform privacy control.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enables seamless privacy management across different platforms and services.
